questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Consider the statement: "P(n) : n^2 - n + 41 is prime". Then which one of the following is true ?
options: P(5) is false but P(3) is true
Both P(3) and P(5) are true
P(3) is false but P(5) is true
Both P(3) and P(5) are false
questions.sol_text:
P(n) = n^2 - n + 41

P(5) = 5^2 - 5 + 41 = 25 - 5 + 41 = 61
61 is prime, so P(5) is true

P(3) = 3^2 - 3 + 41 = 9 - 3 + 41 = 47
47 is prime, so P(3) is true

Both true
